title: anchorterminal.com/tools/liveagent
snippet:
An admin creates keys under Configuration > System > API and sets each key's permissions, and a plan allows 1, 5, 10 or 100 keys.

| Pricing | Paid ($15 / seat-mo) · Four plans at $15, $29, $49 and $69 an agent a month billed annually ($19, $35, $59 and $85 monthly), with the API on every plan. A 30-day trial needs no card, and there is no free plan on the pricing page. MCP actions draw on the account's AI credit budget, whose price was not found (https://www.liveagent.com/pricing/, checked 2026-10-09). |

| Free tier | No free plan on the pricing page. 30-day trial with no card |

- Payments & pricing 30: No x402, MPP or L402 (0). Plan prices are public per agent per month, with nothing per API call (10). A 30-day trial with no card (20). A person signs up in a browser, and the terms say accounts registered by bots or automated methods are not permitted (0).

## Prices
| Item | Price | Unit | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Small Business plan | $15 | per seat per month | per agent a month billed annually, $19 monthly |
| Medium Business plan | $29 | per seat per month | per agent a month billed annually, $35 monthly |
| Large Business plan | $49 | per seat per month | per agent a month billed annually, $59 monthly |
| Enterprise plan | $69 | per seat per month | per agent a month billed annually, $85 monthly |
| Social media channels (add-on) | $39 | per month (plan) | X, Facebook, Viber, Telegram and WhatsApp, Instagram $19 more |

- The 30-day trial needs no card, and the API is included on all four plans from $15 an agent a month billed annually

[### Updating Ticket Custom Fields and Tags Using the LiveAgent API v3
Overview Both tags and custom fields (along with other ticket parameters) can be updated using the API v3 through the PUT endpoint. This allows you to programmatically modify ticket properties without using the web interface. Endpoint Use the following endpoint to update ticket information: PUT /tickets/{ticketId} Replace {ticketId} with the ID of the ticket you want to update.
